name: app-niva-assistant-phone-over-giant-ghost-wordmark-on-white
title: Assistant home screen on a phone over a giant pale 'Niva' wordmark that fades into white
whatItIs: A white rounded frame with a huge pale-grey 'Niva' fading downward behind a centred phone showing the family assistant screen: greeting, question, three action chips, a gradient arc and an Ask Niva input with a blue mic, plus upcoming activity cards at the base.
whatItMeans: Clean and calm; the ghost name gives brand presence without clutter.
techniques: Set a faded giant name behind a phone.
Crop the phone at the bottom.
Use a warm gradient arc as the AI glow.

vocabulary.definition: A giant faint brand name behind content.
A small pill for a quick action.
A device cut by the frame's lower edge.
